```{r}
compute_boxplot_stats_multi <- function(df, group_cols, value_col = "value") {
  df %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    summarise(
      n            = sum(!is.na(.data[[value_col]])),
      min          = min(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q25          = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      median       = median(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q75          = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      max          = max(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      whisker_low  = min,   # full range, no Tukey trimming
      whisker_high = max,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```

```{r}
### Determine the examplar genes for each factor/signature
factor = apply(ds$genesigs, 1, function(x) which.max(x))
ds$genesigs = cbind(factor,ds$genesigs)
rm(factor)

list.topGenes = lapply(2:ncol(ds$genesigs), function(f) {
  i = f-1
  print(i)
  temp = ds$genesigs[ds$genesigs[,1] == i,]
  distance = data.frame(dist = rep(0, nrow(temp)))
  temp = as.data.frame(cbind(distance, temp))
  
  featuresMatrix = temp[,3:dim(temp)[2]]
  
  dists <- apply(featuresMatrix, 1, function(gene_weights) {
    maxWeight = max(gene_weights)
    secMaxWeight = max(gene_weights[gene_weights < maxWeight])
    maxWeight - secMaxWeight
  })
  
  temp$dist <- dists
  temp = temp[order(-temp$dist), , drop = FALSE]
  feature.top250 = rownames(temp)[1:250]
  as.data.frame(c(feature.top250))
})
```

Oh subtype signatures
```{r}
sig.Oh = read.delim(file="/Users/markdings/Documents/PhD/Scripts/PanGI_Network_analysis/classification/classification.by.Oh/41467_2018_4179_MOESM4_ESM_gene_sig.txt")

sig.Oh = sig.Oh[sig.Oh$Symbol %in% rownames(ds$genesigs) ,]
sig.Oh$class = "NA"; 
sig.Oh$class[sig.Oh$S.L.ratios..log2.<0] = "EP"
sig.Oh$class[sig.Oh$S.L.ratios..log2.>0] = "MP"
sig.Oh$class = factor(sig.Oh$class, levels = c("MP", "EP"))

sig.Oh$meta.class = "NA"
sig.Oh$meta.class[sig.Oh$class=="MP"] = "Mesenchymal"
sig.Oh$meta.class[sig.Oh$class=="EP"] = "Epithelial"

sig.Oh = merge(x = sig.Oh, y = ds$genesigs, by.x = "Symbol", by.y = 0)
sig.Oh = sig.Oh %>%
  dplyr::select(Symbol, class, meta.class, f01, f02, f03, f04, f05, f06, f07)

sig.Oh.long = melt(sig.Oh, id.vars = c("Symbol", "class", "meta.class"), measure.vars = c("f01", "f02", "f03", "f04", "f05", "f06", "f07"))

ggplot(sig.Oh.long, aes(x=variable, y=value, fill=class))+geom_boxplot()+scale_fill_manual(values=c(MP="#4f6980",EP="#849db1"))+theme_classic()

p1=ggplot(sig.Oh.long, aes(x=class, y=value, fill=variable))+geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE, outlier.shape = NA)+scale_fill_manual(values=c(f01="#E15759",f03="#4E79A7", f04 = "#ffaa0e"))+theme_classic()+geom_hline(yintercept=1)
p1
```
